_comment: Android app settings for the PSXRecomp Android kit (psxrecomp-android-kit/docs/SETTINGS.md).
title: CARNAGE HEART
disc_prompt:
Choose your Carnage Heart (USA) disc.

Select the .cue file and all three .bin files together
(tap and hold the first one, then tap the others),
or a single .chd file.

They are copied into the app once (about 130 MB).
_launcher_alias: The app's start screen was com.hatdagger.carnageheart.SetupActivity before the kit; keeping the name keeps home-screen icons.
